demo.title: demo.sh
demo.code:
cd borro/scripts

# Rates, what is lent and borrowed, the $BORRO Drip
node borro.mjs read markets

# Lend 1.5 NVDA (approve exactly, deposit, simulated from your wallet)
node borro.mjs plan supply --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET --asset NVDA --amount 1.5

# Short 0.5 TSLA with a 100 USDG deposit, in one transaction
node borro.mjs plan open_short --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET --symbol TSLA --amount 0.5 --deposit 100

# Each plan prints bankr_submit[]: POST them in order to /wallet/submit (chainId 4663)

setup: Chain: Robinhood Chain (4663). Stop if the Bankr wallet cannot act on 4663.
Node 18 or later for scripts/borro.mjs (no dependencies). Or add Borro as an MCP server: https://borro.markets/mcp, no authentication.
Log in to Bankr with a read-write key that has walletApiEnabled; keep 'Enable arbitrary contract calls' on (bankr.bot, Security).
Keep a little ETH on Robinhood Chain for gas: raw submits are not sponsored.
Flow: run a borro.mjs plan → preview summary, quote and warnings → submit bankr_submit[] in order via /wallet/submit with waitForConfirmation.
Approvals are exact, never unlimited. Every target is pinned in known-contracts.json and checked on every plan.
